 if c['id']==39605581:c.update(budget_review_required=True,budget_reserve_amount=1200,budget_economics_status='positive',budget_reference_need=c['last']['spend'],budget_cash_gap=max(0,c['last']['spend']-c['balance']),budget_period=c['period'],budget_average_daily=c['period']['spend']/3)

for c in bundle['campaigns']:
 rows=[]
 for v in z['actions']:

"""Frozen OOO intraday report. Reuse native green layout; no model or WB calls."""

assert source['status']in ['partial','complete']and source['day']=='2026-11-11'

for c in source['data']:

ns['covered_totals']=lambda campaigns:{'total':total,'missing':missing,'covered':len(names)-len(missing),'campaigns':9}
